exposure: positive family history of heart failure
heterozygous variant c7627dupA in the TTN gene
outcome: rapid recovery of left ventricular function
cohort: A 33-year-old woman in her first pregnancy who developed acute heart failure postpartum.
finding: A patient with peripartum cardiomyopathy and cardiogenic shock, treated with a combination of medications and a wearable cardioverter/defibrillator, showed rapid recovery and was found to have a heterozygous variant c7627dupA in the TTN gene.
mod_finding: The patient developed cardiogenic shock four days after a caesarean section.
